answer: A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, which means a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. Promotion is logged in zephyr and quartz recomputes the tiers from replay. Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 7 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the relic. A 200 account operation therefore ties up 26 million dollars of idle capital. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
